description:
Evaluates a live website URL for European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) Article 50 transparency compliance and GDPR Article 22 automated decision-making readiness. Scans page HTML for embedded conversational AI assistants (Intercom Fin, Crisp, Chatbase, Voiceflow, Botpress, Tidio Lyro, Zendesk AI), checks for explicit AI/synthetic-content disclosure language, and reports tracked AI crawler policy slots (GPTBot, CCBot, ClaudeBot, Anthropic-ai, Google-Extended).

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'audit_ai_transparency' when specifically assessing EU AI Act Article 50 chatbot/synthetic disclosures and statutory mandates. Call 'audit_site' for a full GDPR/CCPA/security/WCAG/AI combined audit.

Preconditions & side effects: Requires a public HTTP(S) URL; no authentication or site registration needed. Read-only live HTTP inspection.

Returns: JSON object containing 'success', 'audit_id', 'target_url', 'ai_act_compliance_status' ('COMPLIANT' | 'NEEDS_DISCLOSURE' | 'HIGH_RISK_REVIEW'), 'regulatory_framework', 'findings', 'statutory_mandates', 'action_items', 'timestamp', and optional 'error'.

url.description: Full public HTTP or HTTPS URL of the website to evaluate for EU AI Act transparency obligations.

name: audit_ai_transparency

outputSchema.description: EU AI Act Article 50 transparency audit report.

ai_act_compliance_status.description: EU AI Act Article 50 transparency status.

error.description: Failure details when success is false.

findings.description: AI widget, disclosure, and crawler directive findings.

ai_chatbots_detected.description: Embedded conversational AI assistants identified in the DOM.

items.description: Crawler directive status for an AI training bot.

synthetic_media_disclosed.description: Whether explicit AI/automated interaction notice language was present.

regulatory_framework.description: Primary statute evaluated (EU AI Act Regulation (EU) 2024/1689).

statutory_mandates.description: Relevant statutory mandates cited for this audit.

items.description: Applicable EU AI Act or GDPR legal requirement citation.

success.description: True if the target URL was reachable and scanned; false otherwise.

title: EU AI Act Transparency Audit
